locations.note: A police officer shoots Esteban Diaz outside the family home, Daniel's hidden power tears the street apart, and Sean flees with his little brother.
Near Mount Rainier a gas station owner recognises the fugitive brothers, and travel blogger Brody Holloway helps them escape and finds them a motel, where Daniel learns their father is dead.
When Daniel falls ill, the brothers hide with their grandparents Claire and Stephen, and Daniel befriends Chris next door until the police close in.
The brothers work at Merrill's cannabis farm with the freighthoppers Finn and Cassidy, and a plan to steal his money goes badly wrong.
Sean escapes FBI custody to find Daniel at an isolated commune, where cult leader Lisbeth presents his power as a divine gift.
The brothers spend seven weeks with their mother Karen in the secluded desert community of Away before making for the border.
At a blockaded border crossing Sean chooses to surrender or to force a way through; in three of the four endings one or both brothers reach Puerto Lobos, their father's hometown.

routes.name: Sean and Daniel Diaz
routes.note: Two brothers on the run from Seattle past Mount Rainier to their grandparents in Oregon, the redwoods of Humboldt County, a cult in the Nevada desert and their mother's commune in Arizona, toward their father's hometown across the Mexican border, which they reach only in some endings.
